findings.title: The notes leave out what an owner checks first: their own till, card reader, distributor, and who handles returns

location.description: the three notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: An owner reads "Works with your till" and "Orders from your distributor" and cannot tell whether their own till, card reader or distributor is one of them, or who handles returns. So "Start a 30-day trial" asks them to act on trust.

current.value: The notes name no till, card reader or distributor; "Returns are tracked for you" does not say who tracks them; nothing compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.target: The notes name the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and give one comparison with what the owner does now, such as a stock count or a spreadsheet. The maker must supply these facts.
findings.fix_direction: The maker supplies the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with the owner's current method. Then change "Returns are tracked for you" to name who tracks them. Do not invent any of these facts.

closed_when.check: In the new desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the notes name specific tills, card readers and distributors, say who tracks returns, and give one comparison with what the owner does now.

findings.title: Notes 1 and 2 are 44 and 40 characters per line, under the 45 asked for

location.description: the first two notes under the hero on desktop and widescreen

findings.viewer_experience: The lines are a little short, so the notes break more often than they need to.
findings.target: Notes 1 and 2 at 45 characters per line or more
findings.fix_direction: Widen the notes a little more by narrowing the gap between the columns, if the maker wants the number met.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) and section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more

findings.title: On the phone the "Sold this week" header runs almost to the card's right edge

location.description: the "Sold this week" column header in the table

findings.viewer_experience: It looks tight against the card edge, about 8 px away, though it does not clip.

current.value: about 8 px from the card's right edge

findings.target: More room between the header and the card's right edge
findings.fix_direction: Give that column a little more right padding, or make the title column narrower.

closed_when.check: In the new phone image, the "Sold this week" header has clearly more room before the card's right edge.
